sv-hd-h.title: Fencing and gates for Central Florida homes

sv-hd-ld.paragraph: Vinyl, wood, chain link and gates. Pick a style, or tell us about your yard and we’ll help you choose.

sv0-p.paragraph: White and tan PVC privacy fencing with clean lines, for backyards, side yards and pool areas.

sv1-p.paragraph: Pine privacy fencing with capped posts and matching walk gates, for a classic backyard look.

sv2-p.paragraph: Black chain-link fencing that marks the property line and keeps the view open.

sv3-p.paragraph: Single walk gates and wide double gates, on a new fence or added to one you have, so bigger items fit through.

sv-note.paragraph: Photos marked “Example fence style” show the style only. Fence It Up’s own jobs are in Recent projects below.

wk-hd-h.title: Fences we’ve put up around Orlando

wk-hd-ld.paragraph: Real jobs from our Instagram, labelled by fence type and the area each project was posted from.
